scope: Two existing loading peaks at1.06 mm, alpha5e-7 and2.5e-7: fixed lower-half workpiece global nodal weak ON-body forces in N at actual fixed-body coordinates in mm. Preserve all565 nodes per source, all original nodal/derived/geometry objects,37 row observations, group/whole resultants, moments and total holding reaction. Match exact global node IDs, coordinates, masks and edges; no renumbering, reclassification, small-force filtering, clipping, mirror doubling or new moment integration. Node/group/whole new-minus-baseline differences and fsum/decomposition tail differences are descriptive only, without tolerance or equality gates. ON-body is negative saved internal weak force; saved total holding opposes total ON-body, while material/Hu sign reversals are bookkeeping rather than independent reaction measurements. The shared maximum norm is arrow display scaling only. No pressure, continuous face traction, radial projection, effective grip, free-body response or qualification upgrade. No new science/F/T/HP/equilibrium/tests/API/default changes or old media content/stat reads. The six ordinary JSONs cannot reconstruct the complete deformed mechanism; original manual pages link it.
